findings.finding: Draw summaries associate current tracked pipeline shader hashes with recorded constant-buffer handle/offset/size and slot/space metadata. This is a concrete inspection interface, not camera field identification.

Graphics resource-use reflection and descriptor-table visibility filtering target the pixel stage; vertex-only descriptor-table coverage is not established. Fallback range enumeration is capped at 256 slots per range, not a complete table guarantee.

Snapshot spans presents and internally tracks submission order; entries with unknown submission remain sorted after known ones. DrawSummary serialization omits the internal submission marker, so an MCP-listed draw alone is not proof of submitted/completed GPU work.
The analysis endpoint accepts 2D texture views, not arbitrary constant-buffer readback.

Optional CPU-side constant-buffer cache/history follows map/unmap/update events and defaults off. It is not a per-draw GPU byte snapshot; ongoing writes to an already persistent mapping require separate evidence.

Startup reads settings and boot/live assets and enables resource replacement infrastructure. The separate Crimson Desert game addon registers pre-draw VRS override callbacks. Do not conflate full addon startup with passive metadata observation.
Named pipe rejects remote clients and defaults to a 4 MiB message limit, but its default DACL grants Everyone local generic read/write. Local transport is not an exclusive owner-identity guarantee.

next_owned_qualification: Audit and pin required tool/dependency inputs and isolate startup configuration, empty boot/live paths and output directories.
Use only an explicitly identified owned presenting fixture; prove target/pipe/device identity, timeout/disconnect cleanup and no automatic replacement or dumping.
Test vertex-only and pixel-only bindings, root CBV and descriptor-table CBV, descriptor rebinding, distinct command-list lifetimes, and a recorded but unsubmitted list.
Distinguish serialized metadata from exact per-draw bytes and GPU completion; missing stage/submission information must remain unknown.

A successful owned result still requires a separate reviewed current-game loading and evidence method; neither old game shader hashes nor a VRS override supplies camera control or independent eye scheduling.
scope: Source review supplies a concrete metadata-observation lead with explicit gaps; it neither qualifies current game instrumentation nor rules the approach out. No new archive scan, RenderDoc retry, game probe, bridge registration or configuration change.
